meta.title: ERBA – European Regulatory Burden Alliance
meta.description: Europe's real economy has had enough. Join the movement measuring the real cost of cumulative EU regulation.
meta.joinTitle: Join Free – Add Your Regulatory Pain
meta.joinDescription: Register your company and log the annual cost of your worst EU regulatory burden. Anonymous option available.
meta.loginDescription: Sign in to the ERBA member dashboard.
meta.painIndexTitle: The Pain Index – Documented Cost of EU Regulation
meta.painIndexDescription: Live, crowd-sourced total of annual compliance costs reported by European mid-cap companies, broken down by regulation.

nav.alliance: Comhghuaillíocht Eorpach i gcoinne an ualaigh rialála

footer.blurb: Comhrialtas neamhspleách de POF mid-cap ag taifeadadh chostas carnach rialáil an AE, pointe sonraí i ndiaidh pointe.
footer.anonymousNote: Ní chuirtear aighneachtaí gan ainm i leith chuideachta ainmnithe riamh.

landing.subhead: Tá rialáil charnach an AE ag marú na hiomaíochais. Bí páirteach sa ghluaiseacht a thomhaiseann an fíorchostas.
landing.ctaJoin: Bí páirteach saor – Cuir d’ualach rialála leis
landing.noFees: Gan táillí. Gan bhuiséad stocaireachta. Rogha gan ainm.
landing.whyNowTitle: Tá an fhuinneog chun cúrsa a athrú ag dúnadh.
landing.whyNowLead: Tháinig trí fhórsa le chéile in 18 mí. Le chéile déanann siad an tost níos daoire ná an chaint.
landing.farmerBody: Chuir tarracóirí bac ar an mBruiséil, Páras agus Beirlín. Chruthaigh feirmeoirí, nuair a bhrúnn an fíorgheilleagar le chéile, éisteann an Coimisiún. Níor ardaigh mid-caps a nguth fós.
landing.greenBody: CSRD, CSDDD, EUDR, CBAM, an Tacsanomaíocht. Breathnaíonn gach riail ina haonar 'inbhainistithe'. Le chéile slogann siad foirne airgeadais agus dlí iomlána.
landing.mercosurBody: Osclaíonn comhaontuithe trádála an doras do iomaitheoirí gan na hoibleagáidí seo. Easpórtálann an Eoraip a bonn tionsclaíoch agus iompórtálann sí earraí a tháirgtear faoi rialacha níos éadroime.
landing.howTitle: Uimhir amháin nach féidir leis an mBruiséil a chonspóid.
landing.howLead: Cuirtear scéalta i leataobh. Sonraí costais chomhiomlánaithe infhíoraithe, ní. Déanann ERBA pointe cláir de do phian comhlíonta.
landing.step1Body: Dhá nóiméad. Gan ainm más fearr leat.
landing.step2Body: Roghnaigh an rialáil is troime agus meastachán a dhéanamh ar an ualach bliantúil.
landing.step3Body: Cothaíonn do shonraí an Pain Index poiblí nach féidir le lucht déanta beartas a neamhaird.
landing.closeTitle: Is fíric pholaitiúil é do chostas comhlíonta.
landing.closeLead: Bí páirteach le {count} cuideachta atá cláraithe cheana. Tógann sé níos lú ná riachtanas CSRD amháin a léamh.

join.title: Cuir do chostas comhlíonta ar an taifead.
join.lead: Tá {count} cuideachta tar éis {cost} d’ualach rialála a dhoiciméadú cheana. Déanann gach pointe nua an uimhir níos deacra a neamhaird.
join.anonBody: Áirítear an costas; is féidir ainm na cuideachta a choinneáil i bhfolach.
join.neverBody: Comhiomlánaítear sonraí le haghaidh abhcóideachta amháin, ní roinntear le díoltóirí riamh.

login.title: Fáilte ar ais
login.lead: Logáil isteach chuig an War Room, seicliostaí agus rianaire atreoraithe.
login.subtitle: Logáil isteach chuig an War Room agus rianaire atreoraithe.
login.confirmationFailed: Tá an nasc deimhnithe neamhbhailí nó in éag. Logáil isteach thíos nó cláraigh arís.
login.notConfigured: Níl an tsamhail seo ceangailte le Supabase fós.
login.genericError: Níorbh fhéidir logáil isteach. Seiceáil na sonraí.

wizard.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, including a letter and a number.
wizard.anonymousHint: Your cost data still counts in the Pain Index, but your company name is never displayed publicly.
wizard.selectRegulation: Select the regulation that hurts most
wizard.costHint: Include staff time, consultants, audits, software and legal fees.
wizard.confirmBody: Your company and regulatory pain have been recorded. We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click it to unlock your member dashboard.
wizard.duplicate: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
wizard.placeholderDescription: e.g. Two FTEs now spend 60% of their time on double-materiality assessments and supplier questionnaires.
wizard.genericError: Something went wrong while creating your account. Please try again.
wizard.noUser: Sign-up succeeded but no user was returned.

validation.email: Enter a valid work email address
validation.passwordShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
validation.regulation: Select the regulation that hurts most
validation.cost: Enter an estimated annual cost in EUR
validation.costPositive: Cost must be greater than zero

painIndex.title: The Pain Index
painIndex.lead: Total annual compliance cost documented by European companies, regulation by regulation.
painIndex.leaderboardTitle: Which regulation costs Europe the most?
painIndex.ranked: Ranked by total documented annual cost
painIndex.emptyBody: The Pain Index starts with the first company brave enough to put a number on it. Be the first data point.
painIndex.method: Methodology: figures are self-reported annual compliance cost estimates submitted by member companies. Company identities are never displayed; anonymous submissions are included in aggregates. Totals refresh every minute.
painIndex.cta: Is your company facing these costs?

dashboardNav.rlsNote: Company-scoped data is protected by Postgres row-level security. Only members of your organisation can read your tasks and documents.

dashboard.perk3: A seat in the annual Brussels CEO delegation
dashboard.perk4: Objection-letter templates for every new Green Deal act

notFound.title: Níor aimsíodh an leathanach
notFound.body: Féadfaidh an rialáil a bheith gan deireadh; níl an URL seo. Ar ais chuig an ngluaiseacht.
